products.name: Flexi-Loan
products.summary: Flexible business loan / revolving credit facility for UK businesses: borrow £1,000 to £1,000,000, draw down and repay flexibly, pay interest only on what you use, with no fees for early repayment.
products.term: 1 day to 5 years (see source caveat on the minimum term)
products.representative_apr: 49% APR representative (approx. 3.33% interest per 30 days). At least 51% of customers borrowing £25,000 or less receive the representative APR or a lower rate.
products.representative_example: Borrow £10,000 for 12 months at 49% representative APR. Interest rate 40% p.a. (fixed). Total amount repayable £12,165. (Note: total repayable figure varies across iwoca pages — see caveats.)
products.fees: Interest is charged only on the amount drawn, for the days it is used. No fees for repaying early.
products.repayment: Minimum repayments made weekly or monthly per the schedule agreed at drawdown; repay early at any time with no early-repayment fee.
products.security: Unsecured, with no asset requirements. For limited companies, iwoca asks for a personal guarantee from a company director.
eligibility: Limited company or LLP / partnership (iwoca states it no longer lends to sole traders)
No minimum turnover and no minimum trading history stated
Startups with no trading history: maximum up to £10,000
products.notes: Credit limit is based on the business profile, typically up to around two months' turnover.

products.name: iwocaPay
products.summary: Business-to-business 'Pay Later' (BNPL) option at checkout for trade customers. Sellers get paid instantly; buyers can spread the cost. iwocaPay carries the credit risk with no recourse to the seller.
products.term: Buyers can spread the cost over 1, 3 or 12 months.
products.representative_apr: [VERIFY] — interest rate is based on the buyer's business and is not published as a single figure.
products.fees: No subscription fees; charges apply only when Pay Later is used. The seller chooses either a fixed percentage on each Pay Later transaction (interest-free for the buyer) or free-for-the-seller with interest-bearing terms for the buyer. Buyers pay only for the days they use and can settle early to save on interest. Exact fees are tailored per business.
products.repayment: Buyers repay iwocaPay in instalments over 1, 3 or 12 months and can settle early.
eligibility: Buyers: any UK limited company can spread the cost of up to £30,000
Sellers: UK businesses selling to other businesses
products.notes: Sellers are paid instantly via Faster Payments. iwocaPay takes on the credit risk (no recourse to the seller).
